notes: Fixtures are real spec.html files produced by /r:spec-brainstorm, kept in brainstorm-workspace/iteration-1. Each run points the skill at one and checks the resulting todo.md. Mechanical assertions are checked by scripts/check_todo.py --spec <the spec>, which also verifies the dependency graph, the derived waves and leaf self-containment; the rest are judgment. The skill must not re-decide anything the documents already settled, and must not write file:LINE or a reuse map — those are /r:task-run's planner's, written against real code.

evals.name: enterprise-spec-to-plan
evals.expected_output: todo.md beside the spec. 18-35 phases grouped under named milestones, 10-18 in v1. Every FR in the spec reaches a phase. Phases touching money, auth, persistence or concurrency carry a Risk line. Unknowns whose mitigation is 'investigate', and any non-engineering work, appear under '## Resolve first' with an owner and the phase they block — not as numbered phases.

assertions.text: Writes docs/<topic>/todo.md beside the spec, never a root todo.md
Every user story in the spec is named verbatim by at least one phase
Cites no requirement id the spec doesn't define
18-35 total phases, 10-18 in v1, grouped under named milestones
Numbering starts at 1, gap-free, continuous across v1 and Advanced
Every phase's Done when names a runnable command or observable response
Phases touching money, auth, persistence, concurrency or security carry a Risk line
Unknowns and non-engineering work appear in an unnumbered '## Resolve first' section, never as a numbered phase
Does not re-decide the stack or invent requirements the spec doesn't contain
No phase exceeds 12 checklist items
Every numbered phase is work a coding agent can branch, implement and open a PR for
Every leaf carries a Depends on line ('—' when it has none), and no leaf depends on a higher-numbered leaf
The dependency graph is acyclic
No two leaves in the same derived wave name the same file
No leaf item defers to the milestone Design section — /r:task-run lifts only the leaf's own block
Each milestone's Design section carries schema with real column types and indexes, endpoint signatures with status codes, types and module boundaries
No file:LINE reference and no reuse map anywhere — those are written at execution time against real code

evals.name: small-spec-to-plan
evals.expected_output: A short plan: 3-6 phases, 3-5 in v1. No spike unless the spec names a real high/high unknown. No Files lines required, since the codebase doesn't exist yet.

assertions.text: Writes todo.md beside the spec
3-6 total phases, 3-5 in v1 — proportionate to a weekend project
Every user story in the spec is named verbatim by at least one phase
Every phase's Done when names a runnable command
No 'Resolve first' entries invented, no milestone grouping, no Risk lines on phases that don't warrant them
Phases are vertical slices leaving the app runnable, not horizontal layers

evals.name: existing-codebase-plan
evals.expected_output: Reads the repo before writing phases. Every phase carries a Files line naming real existing paths. Migrations start at V2 because V1__init.sql is already applied. Respects the outbox pattern and the no-comments convention from CLAUDE.md.

assertions.text: Writes docs/returns-refunds/todo.md inside the repo
Every phase carries a Files line, since the codebase already exists
Named files either exist in the repo or are created by an earlier phase
New migrations start at V2 and never edit V1__init.sql
Every user story in the spec reaches a phase, named verbatim
Money and persistence phases carry a Risk line for /r:task-run tiering
Honours the repo's CLAUDE.md rules (outbox, append-only Flyway, no code comments)
Every leaf carries a Depends on line ('—' when it has none), and no leaf depends on a higher-numbered leaf
The dependency graph is acyclic
No two leaves in the same derived wave name the same file
No leaf item defers to the milestone Design section — /r:task-run lifts only the leaf's own block

evals.name: no-spec-present
evals.prompt: make a todo for the payments rewrite
evals.expected_output: Finds no spec, says so, and points at /r:spec-brainstorm rather than inventing a spec to plan against. Writes no files.

assertions.text: Does not invent a specification to plan against
Writes no todo.md
Points at /r:spec-brainstorm to produce a spec first

evals.name: routing-triggers
evals.prompt: break this spec into phases with a runnable done-when check for each
evals.expected_output: spec-design loads, reads the spec, and writes a phased todo.md with stable ids, real file paths and a check that can actually be run.

evals.name: routing-excludes-spec-brainstorm
evals.prompt: I have an idea for a bot that watches our deploys — how should I build it?
evals.expected_output: Designing something that has not been specified yet is spec-brainstorm's job; spec-design must not load, because there is no spec to phase.

evals.name: shallow-skips-the-design-pass
evals.expected_output: The build order alone: milestones, leaves, Depends on and checklists, with no milestone Design sections and no code-level contracts in the items. The graph is still complete, so the wave table is still derived.

assertions.text: No milestone carries a Design section
Every leaf still carries Depends on, and the wave table is still derivable
Checklist items name the work without the schema/endpoint/signature detail the full pass adds

evals.name: several-documents-that-disagree
evals.expected_output: Reads both, says what it took from each, and where the two disagree records it under Open questions rather than silently picking one. Neither document's requirements go missing.

assertions.text: Names both documents and what was taken from each
A disagreement between the documents reaches Open questions, never a quiet resolution
Requirements from the second document reach leaves too

evals.name: routing-triggers-parallelism-ask
evals.prompt: turn these docs into a build plan and tell me which parts we can build in parallel
evals.expected_output: spec-design loads, decomposes the documents into milestones and leaf phases, writes a Depends on line on every leaf, and reports the derived wave table naming which leaves may be built concurrently.

evals.name: routing-excludes-plan-run
evals.prompt: work through docs/billing/todo.md and build all the remaining phases
evals.expected_output: Executing a plan that already exists is plan-run's job; spec-design must not load, because there is nothing to decompose — the phases are already written.
